rows.text: The PT announces that its 17th Encontro Nacional will meet in Brasília on 1, 2 and 3 August 2025 and that the posse of the president-elect Edinho Silva and the other Diretório Nacional members will take place on Sunday 3 August (programme: 10h act with President Lula for the posse of the Diretório and the president-elect).
